name: Synthesize Bio
description: Synthesize Bio lets Claude generate and analyze gene expression data from a virtual human from a natural language prompt. Describe any experiment — "tumor vs normal lung tissue" or "KRAS knockout vs control" — and the platform generates realistic human expression profiles using its Gene Expression Model (GEM). You can use this gene expression data just as if you had done a laboratory experiment on human samples. Supports both bulk and single-cell RNA-seq modalities. See https://www.synthesize.bio/ to learn more about virtual humans, GEM, and to register for an account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Synthesize Bio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Synthesize Bio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.synthesize.bio/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Synthesize Bio MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Synthesize Bio provides these MCP tools: resolve_sample_metadata, analyze_gene_expression, get_analysis_results, get_saved_analysis_report, annotate_genes, and get_counts_data_url.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Synthesize Bio?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Synthesize Bio in life-sciences on the Manufact MCP catalog include AdisInsight, Boltz API, Helix GenoSphere, Inductive Bio, and LatchBio.

_published_faq.name: Does Synthesize Bio MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Synthesize Bio requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Synthesize Bio is developed by Synthesize Bio. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
